artist_statement: GEGYjiji is a Chinese watercolor artist based in Tokyo, originally from Hunan Province, who studied illustration and design at Beijing Fashion Institute. Since 2020 she has maintained a daily watercolor practice — a series called 'diary' — that her first solo collection, Colour Diary (October 2021), grew directly from. Her paintings move through the ordinary: red walls and alleyways, pools and green ponds, the interiors of rooms, the particular warmth of sunlight in a familiar street. Like a train traveling through the north, her work carries all four seasons and gives the viewer the feeling of walking through a place they half-remember. She made her first Japan exhibition in February 2023 as part of Tide from China Part1 at ACG_Labo in Harajuku, Tokyo.
